Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics experiment analyzed the ubiquitinated proteome of GM00637 cells. While whole-cell lysates were the starting material, the material actually analyzed by MS was specifically enriched via immunoprecipitation of K-ε-GG peptides using an antibody, which fits the 'affinity-purified complex scope' (PPA:0000202) as it is an antibody-captured sub-fraction of the proteome. HEK293T cells were used for validation (Western Blot/RT-qPCR) and a separate mentioned pull-down that failed to detect the target, but the main dataset PXD035401 is based on the GM00637 K-ε-GG enrichment.
